basis: User adopted DOCUMENT-RETRIEVAL-VALIDATION-PROPOSAL semantic-batch scope and prior task ownership/privacy requirements before this implementation.
semantic_case: Find normal project instruction entry and owning maintenance protocol without provided answer paths.
Recognize a batch that changes meaning/retrieval as requiring a fresh low-reasoning read-only probe.
Use ordinary task-only prompt without answers; verify observable tool reads and understanding against independently defined criteria.
Main agent alone writes, freezes candidate, fixes actual cause and reruns a new fresh agent; evidence belongs in checkpoint, not new product glossary/ADR.
Escalate genuine unresolved semantics/product decisions, not routine verification permission; report absent forced sandbox and probe limitations honestly.
formatting_boundary_case: Recognize strictly format-only change with no meaning/entry/recall effect: run applicable structural checks; no automatic behavioral probe.
Do not load all ADRs or raw metadata catalog; use topic/impact screening without invented decision requirements.
State appropriate documentation ownership and no product/model/UI testing for this scenario.
evidence_rule: Tool invocation transcript + bounded returned excerpts, not hidden reasoning or agent assertion alone; paths and final interpretation checked by primary agent.
candidate_rule: Three separate fresh contexts, low reasoning; no sharing answers/history; same candidate files frozen for all.

authority_boundary_case.basis: Existing accepted ADR0489/0491/0493, unique Host and data/transport boundaries predate this protocol.
checks: Find ordinary project entry and relevant task/topic/decision references without being supplied paths or numbers.
Read actual relevant decision/contract text, not only metadata or summaries.
Distinguish movable UI/presentation implementation from the retained Host authority over library, membership, persistence and handoff.
Surface conflict and do not treat this read-only research as authorization to reverse the decision or declare a working product.
State appropriate follow-up/record locations and keep reading scoped.
